about.title: Mill Valley Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Mill Valley's tight, tree-lined streets funnel traffic onto a handful of corridors — Miller Avenue, Camino Alto, E Blithedale Avenue, and the US-101 approach — and that concentration shows up in the numbers, with 43 injury collisions and 60 people hurt in the most recent reporting year. Fridays around midday tend to see more reported crashes than other times, likely tied to weekend traffic building through downtown and toward the highway. If you were injured in one of these collisions, what happens in the days right after matters. Insurance adjusters move quickly, and early recorded statements can be used against you later. LawProactive doesn't practice law itself; we simply connect injured Mill Valley residents and visitors with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate the crash, handle communications with insurers, and explain your options — all without any upfront cost to you.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Talking to the Insurer

items.title: California's Filing Clock Is Shorter Than You Think
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but if a government vehicle or road defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. An attorney can flag these deadlines early so evidence and claims aren't lost to time.

items.title: Comparative Fault Rules Reward Careful Documentation
items.desc: California allows you to recover damages even if you're partly at fault, with your share of responsibility reducing your award rather than erasing it. That makes preserving evidence from the scene — photos, witness names, dashcam footage — especially valuable before memories fade or footage is overwritten.

items.title: No Cap on Pain-and-Suffering Damages Means Insurers Push Back Harder
items.desc: Because California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases, insurance adjusters often try to minimize claims through quick recorded statements. An independent attorney can handle that communication so nothing you say is used to undervalue your injuries.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers are trained to ask questions that can shift blame or minimize your injuries, even if you're simply trying to be cooperative. An independent attorney can communicate with the insurer on your behalf instead.

items.question: Is Miller Avenue or E Blithedale Avenue more likely to be involved in a crash claim?
items.answer: Public crash data shows both corridors, along with Camino Alto and the US-101 approach, account for a meaningful share of Mill Valley's reported injury collisions. That doesn't mean either road is uniquely hazardous — it reflects where traffic volume concentrates. What matters most for your claim is documenting exactly where and how your crash happened.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward after speaking with an attorney.
